meta: Negotiating salary in an interview: the common mistake is naming a first number that's too low, just from lack of preparation.

muc.title: A first number too low
muc.text: The common mistake in salary talks is naming a first number that's too low, simply because you didn't prepare.

muc.title: Find the going rate yourself
muc.text: AI doesn't know today's market pay, so look at similar job ads and ask people in the field.

muc.title: Three reasons for your range
muc.text: Ask AI to list your skills, projects and results, and turn them into three reasons for the range you want.

muc.title: Role-play a lowball
muc.text: Then ask AI to play someone offering low, so you can practice answering calmly while holding your range.

muc.title: Three practice rounds
muc.text: Ask AI to play the recruiter and practice three rounds of answering the expected-salary question.
